headline: Precious metals plunge in broad tech rout while energy retreats
paragraphs: Precious metals led market declines, driven by a cracking AI rally and wider tech rout that spurred a search for cash. Silver tumbled 5.86% to $49.13 (EUR 43.94) to breach the $50 threshold, platinum dropped 4.03% to $1434.50 (EUR 1282.77), and gold sank 3.63% to a one-year low of $3884.90 (EUR 3473.99).

Natural gas slid 2.34% to $2.88 (EUR 2.58) on the day, though the specific cause for the daily drop is unclear; across the week, it gained 9.20% on warnings of potential winter price shocks as European storage levels dwindle. Palladium lost 2.31% to $977.50 (EUR 874.11), with white metals facing added pressure following US PCE data.
Brent crude fell 2.22% to $112.33 (EUR 100.45) as oil flows expanded with easing turmoil around the Iran war.
